title: A colored display
hook: A body part can become a visible signal.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The highlighted flap in this schematic is a dewlap, a throat structure that some lizards extend during displays. A visible display can have different functions; a single image does not establish an animal’s intention.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: When a lizard extends its dewlap during a display, which structure comes into view?
